_meta.purpose: D-139, D-140: the kind of pack (food, supplement, infant, special_medical, not_food), decided by core/pack_kind.py from words printed on the pack, and which parts of the result each kind shows (lenses/screen.py). The model only copies the words (prompt rule 11); this table and the rule decide (D-004).
rules: Every phrase is printed words a regulation names, cited in `basis` with the page, read first-hand (D-046). Phrases are matched as whole words on the text lower-cased, apostrophes removed, hyphens and punctuation as spaces.

Order: licence (D-116 extended) first, then medical words, then infant words, then supplement words, then the catalogue's category, else food. Medical words come before infant words so that a preterm, hypoallergenic or other special medical infant food is special_medical (docs/BABY_FOOD.md section 2).
An ordinary food must come out exactly as before D-139 (tests/test_pack_kind.py pins the six gold labels).
Parts not built yet (phase 2 supplements, phase 3 infant checks) are simply absent from a kind's list.

nutra.title: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, Food for Special Medical Purpose and Prebiotic and Probiotic Food) Regulations, 2022, Annexure 1, as operationalised by FSSAI's direction of 18 October 2022

infant.title: FSS (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020, compendium Version II (04.01.2024)

fss_act.title: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, section 3(1)(j)

supplement.why: D-139 phase 2: FSSAI's supplement rules and ICMR-NIN's requirements (lenses/nutra.py); no score, grade, band or NOVA count, which weigh the ingredients of a food.

infant.why: D-140 (Sushil, 2026-09-30): infant foods ship in shadow. The server itself withholds every result field (no score, grade or band, no claim or nutrition result) and refuses /compare; the breastfeeding line waits for the lawyer.

words.basis: nutra 6(4)(f), Annexure 1 p. 14; infant 16(3)(a), PDF p. 37

phrases: recommended to be used under medical advice only
recommended to be taken under medical advice only

words.basis: nutra 6(4)(f)(i)(B), Annexure 1 p. 14; infant 16(3)(b), PDF p. 37

phrases: for use in specific conditions under medical guidance only
mothers milk is best for your baby
infant food shall be introduced only after the age of six months

words.basis: infant 2(1)(e), (h), (i), (j), PDF pp. 1 to 2; 7(3), PDF p. 12

company_words.why: A company's name is not a kind: "Testco Nutraceuticals Pvt Ltd" says nothing about the pack. Text with any of these words never decides a kind.

supporting.note: Supporting evidence only: alone it doesn't decide (docs/SUPPLEMENTS.md 2.1).

licences.basis: D-116 (FSS Act 3(1)(j): "food" does not include "drugs and medicinal products"); the FSSAI logo and 14-digit licence number, as D-116's reviewer checks them
